svg.title: Better intervals still miss the reliability floor
svg.desc: Descriptor CQR worst groups: 86 of 183 at 15 minutes; 124 of 231 at 60 minutes. Both are weather-outage ramp groups in Q1 2020. Dashed 80% is a permissive research criterion, not an industry standard.
